liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review, 1 other source): In the China>Rider pairing, Phil's bass sits prominent in the mix and drives hard; China Cat Sunflower flows directly into I Know You Rider [1][6]
- **Dark Star** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls the Dark Star sweet; Dark Star breaks into a jam, returns to Dark Star, jams again, then goes into Me And Bobby McGee [1][3]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Performed with a funky feel [5]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer points to the early Jack Straw as worth checking out [3]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Jerry's jamming here anticipates how later versions would go [4]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Singled out by the reviewer as a favorite highlight [8]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 other source): Saint Stephen segues straight into Johnny B. Goode [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-10-24.sbd.miller.125887.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 152 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd71-10-24.sbd.clugston.3292.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 4.16/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording has heavy tape hiss, though the band sounds good; Hiss is present but only a minor issue; Keith's piano tone on this early recording is pleasing [3][5][9][12]

## Around the show

- Keith plays organ, a rare occurrence; the recording's opening is slightly cut [4]
- Bobby cracks silly jokes during the show [5]
- Pig Pen was absent through illness, which is why a new keyboardist was brought in [11]
- The roughly 20-minute Dark Star is judged as strong as the 2/18 and 4/28 versions [4]
- Playing In The Band is jammier than earlier versions, though not yet jazzy [8]
- Like most 1971 shows, it favors steady, loose jams, with Keith and no Pigpen [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-10-24.sbd.miller.125887.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]
- **gd71-10-24.sbd.clugston.3292.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT > CDR [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1971-10-23 GD NRPS Poster - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1971-10-23-gd-nrps-poster/) [16]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1971-10-24 Easttown Theatre, Detroit, MI - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1971-10-24-easttown-theatre-detroit-mi/) [17]
